summary.zh: 按项目技术栈生成 lint、测试、构建和部署流水线
summary.en: Generate a CI/CD workflow from the stack the repository uses

description.zh: 识别仓库的技术栈后，生成包含 lint、测试、构建和部署的 CI/CD 工作流，可直接放进仓库使用。适合新项目还没有 CI、想把测试挂到 push 上，或需要一份能跑通的流水线定义时使用。部署步骤需要在平台上配置凭据与运行环境。
description.en: Detects the repo's stack, then generates a CI/CD workflow that runs lint, tests, build and deploy, ready to drop into the repository. Use it for projects without CI. Deploy steps need credentials and runners on the platform.
